title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

What You'll Be Doing
- You will design, develop, test, and support applications using .NET and JADE.
- You will build and maintain APIs, integrations, and cloud-based solutions.
- You will enhance and modernize existing platforms and services.
- You will troubleshoot production issues and implement sustainable fixes.
- You will contribute to CI/CD, automation, code reviews, and engineering best practices.
- You will mentor team members and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders.
- You will leverage AI tools to improve development efficiency, quality, and delivery.

What we're looking for:
- You have 6+ years of software development experience.
- You have strong expertise in C#, .NET Framework, .NET Core, and .NET 8+.
- You have hands-on experience with JADE development, databases, and workflows.
- You have experience building and supporting REST APIs, integrations, and SQL Server solutions.
- You have knowledge of AWS services including EC2, Lambda, RDS, S3, API Gateway, and CloudWatch.
- You are familiar with Agile delivery practices and modern engineering standards.
- Experience with React, JavaScript, or TypeScript is good to have
- You are comfortable using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Microsoft Copilot, or ChatGPT.

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.
Recruitment Fraud Awareness - Experian's recruitment process is conducted only through authorised channels. Recruitment communications will only be sent from an @experian.com email address. Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.
Life at Experian

Support for every family: Maternity, paternity and adoption leave for all parents, plus subsidised childcare for all employees.

Care when it matters most: Employee Assistance Program, Mental Health First Aiders, and compassionate and domestic violence leave.

Flexibility that fits your life: Flexible work arrangements, with generous annual, sick and family care leave.

A community where you belong: Employee Resource Groups, paid volunteer leave and recognition through our One Experian program.

Growth at every stage: Career mentoring, Harvard Manage Mentor, Experian University and e-learning platforms.

title: Senior Web Engineer (AI Fluent)
description:
Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more. Experian invests in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. We have an amazing team of 25,200 people in 32 countries.

What you'll be doing:
Experian Partner Solutions is looking for Senior Web Engineers to build the products our partners white label as their own – embedded components that run inside partner applications, and hosted sites that carry a partner's brand. When a partner puts our software in front of their customers, our code runs under their brand, in their environment, with their reputation attached. There is no margin for "it works on my machine."
Predominantly JavaScript and TypeScript across the browser and the server – React on the front end, Node in our services and tooling.
We are building this team around AI-assisted development. That is not a perk in the job description – it is the operating model. You will spend a significant share of your time directing AI coding agents, reviewing what those agents produce, and being personally accountable for code you did not type character by character.
- Oversee web software end-to-end – develop, and support it in production. Overseeership does not stop at the merge.
- Direct AI coding agents as your primary implementation method rather than hand-writing every line.
- Make the architecture calls AI cannot make for you: interface and API design, state and service boundaries, versioning, and backward compatibility for consumers who depend on your releases.
- Design for environments you do not control, whether that is a hostile host page, an unfamiliar partner configuration, or an unexpected client of your API.
- Use AI to create test suites and regression coverage, then look for what the generator missed: adversarial inputs, integration conflicts, and configuration edge cases.
Agentic Responsibilities:
- Use AI coding assistants – Claude Code, Copilot, Cursor, Kiro, or equivalent – as a primary development tool.
- Decompose a non-trivial feature into chunks an agent completes reliably.
- Explain what makes a prompt produce usable code rather than plausible-looking garbage.
- Use AI to create tests, paired with a clear view of where those tests give false confidence.

What We're Looking For:
- 6+ years building and shipping production web software, with ownership of what you built after it went live.
- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent experience.
- JavaScript and TypeScript, applied across the browser and the server. We work in React and Node; expertise in a comparable ecosystem plus evidence you pick up new stacks quickly is equally welcome.
- Component libraries, design systems, or SDKs consumed by teams outside your own — where breaking changes carry cost.
- You will directly report to Director

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's people first, inclusive and purpose driven culture is multi award-winning; World's Best Workplaces™ 2025 (Fortune Global Top 25), Great Place To Work™ in 26 countries to name a few. Check out Experian Life on social or explore our Careers Site to understand why. Experian is also proud to be an Equal Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know at the earliest opportunity.

Experian will never ask candidates to make any payment as part of an application, interview, assessment, onboarding, or recruitment process. To apply for roles or verify opportunities, please visit experian.com/careers.
Benefits
- Support for every family: Maternity, paternity and adoption leave for all parents, plus subsidised childcare for all employees.
- Health Care when it matters most: Employee Assistance Program, Mental Health First Aiders, and compassionate and domestic violence leave.
- Flexibility that fits your life: Flexible work arrangements with generous annual, sick and family care leave.
- A community where you belong: Employee Resource Groups, paid volunteer leave and recognition through our One Experian program.

title: Sr Software Engineer
description:
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.

As a Senior AI Full-Stack Product Engineer at ServiceNow, you will build AI-powered product experiences that solve meaningful Field Service Management customer problems. You will combine full-stack software engineering, product thinking, and hands-on AI development to deliver reliable, scalable production capabilities.
What you get to do in this role:
- Own end-to-end development across user interfaces, backend services, AI capabilities, enterprise data, and integrations.
- Partner with product managers, designers, and domain experts to understand customer needs and determine where AI delivers meaningful value.
- Build applications using large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), structured outputs, tool calling, and agentic workflows.
- Develop conversational and multimodal experiences across web, chat, and voice, with attention to usability, context, latency, and reliability.
- Integrate AI capabilities with enterprise APIs, data, and business workflows while enforcing security, privacy, and access controls.
- Design multi-step AI workflows with appropriate autonomy, human handoffs, exception handling, and recovery.
- Develop and refine prompts, system instructions, and tool definitions using evaluations and production feedback.
- Build scalable application services with testing, observability, error handling, and performance optimization.
- Prototype rapidly and turn successful experiments into maintainable production software.
- Use AI coding tools effectively while maintaining engineering quality and security.
- Provide technical leadership, mentor engineers, and establish reusable development patterns.

To be successful in this role, you have:
- A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field.
- A strong track record of building and operating production software, including hands-on experience developing AI/LLM-powered applications.
- Full-stack development experience spanning user-facing applications, backend services, APIs, and data models.
- Strong software engineering fundamentals in system design, distributed systems, testing, and production operations.
- Practical knowledge of prompting, context management, RAG, structured outputs, tool calling, and agent orchestration.
- Experience integrating applications with enterprise data, APIs, workflows, and external systems.
- An understanding of AI application trade-offs, including latency, cost, reliability, hallucination, grounding, security, and data privacy.
- The ability to use evaluations, tracing, and observability to diagnose failures and improve production behavior.
- Strong product judgment and the ability to take ambiguous customer problems from concept to production.
- Effective collaboration, communication, technical leadership, and mentoring skills.
 
Preferred qualifications:
- Experience building agentic applications and multi-step autonomous workflows.
- Experience with conversational, multimodal, voice, streaming, or real-time AI applications.
- Experience delivering AI-powered enterprise workflows.
- Experience with AI coding agents, rapid prototyping, and developer productivity tools.
- Forward deployment experience, working directly with customers to implement solutions and demonstrate measurable outcomes.
- Experience building products used by enterprise customers.

Work Personas
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.

title: Senior Software Engineer - GitHub
description:
Overview
As part of this team, you will work on mission-critical platform services that power GitHub's global developer ecosystem. The team owns and operates high-scale distributed systems, including GitHub Packages, GitHub Pages, Email Services, and other foundational developer experience tools and platforms. These services support billions of requests, stringent reliability requirements, and developer workflows used worldwide. 

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will provide technical leadership for some of GitHub's most challenging scale, reliability, and operational excellence initiatives. You will lead design and implementation, make sound architectural decisions, mentor engineers, and collaborate across GitHub and Microsoft to deliver durable platform capabilities. 

Responsibilities
- Lead the design, development, and operation of highly available distributed systems that power critical GitHub platform services. 

- Drive architecture and technical direction for scalable backend services and platform capabilities using modern engineering practices, automation, and observability. 

- Define and deliver improvements to service reliability, performance, latency, capacity, security, and operational efficiency for mission-critical workloads. 

- Own complex features and services throughout their lifecycle, from requirements and design reviews through implementation, rollout, production support, and live-site excellence. 

- Build automation and reusable platform capabilities that reduce operational overhead and improve engineering productivity across teams. 

- Lead investigations of complex production issues across distributed systems, storage, networking, and service infrastructure, and drive durable corrective actions. 

- Partner with engineers and stakeholders across GitHub and Microsoft to align technical strategy and deliver large-scale platform investments and modernization efforts. 

- Mentor engineers, raise engineering standards through design and code reviews, and leverage AI-assisted workflows to improve software delivery, testing, incident response, and operational excellence. 

Qualifications
Required 

- Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. 

- 7+ years of professional software engineering experience designing, building, and operating production systems. 

- Expert coding skills in one or more programming languages such as C#, Java, Go, C++, Python, Ruby, or similar, with a track record of delivering maintainable production software. 

- Deep understanding of data structures, algorithms, concurrency, API design, and distributed systems fundamentals. 

- Proven experience designing and operating large-scale backend services, cloud systems, or platform infrastructure with high availability and reliability requirements. 

- Strong experience with databases, caching systems, messaging technologies, service-oriented architectures, and observability practices. 

- Demonstrated ability to lead ambiguous technical projects, influence architecture across teams, mentor engineers, and communicate effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders. 

Preferred 

- Experience with public cloud platforms, Kubernetes, and containerized services in production. 

- Experience architecting high-throughput, highly available internet-scale systems and planning for capacity, resilience, and disaster recovery. 

- Strong knowledge of observability, incident management, reliability engineering, security, and production operations. 

- Experience with GitHub, CI/CD systems, developer platforms, package management ecosystems, or internal platform products. 

- Familiarity with Go, Ruby, MySQL, Kubernetes, distributed storage, service infrastructure, and large-scale system migrations. 

What Makes This Role Exciting 

- Lead work on services operating at hyperscale, with billions of requests and global developer impact. 

- Own production systems where reliability, performance, security, and operational excellence directly affect millions of developers. 

- Shape technical direction and drive end-to-end engineering outcomes across complex, multi-team initiatives. 

- Collaborate with and influence GitHub engineering teams worldwide while mentoring other engineers. 

- Solve complex distributed systems, concurrency, scalability, and reliability challenges every day.

title: Software Engineer 2 - Frontend
description:
Overview
Search is how people find their work. Every day, people in organizations of every size rely on it to locate the document they edited last week, the email that captured a decision, the colleague who knows the answer, or the meeting where it was all discussed. When search works, it disappears into the flow of work; when it does not, it costs time, focus and confidence.
In Microsoft 365 Copilot, we are reimagining search with AI. Copilot Search understands what you mean, brings together email, files, chats, meetings and people, and composes a grounded answer with sources you can trust, right alongside the results you need to go deeper. We are looking for a Software Engineer II excited to build this experience at global scale.
Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities
- Design, build and ship Copilot Search features end to end in React and TypeScript, from design review and implementation through experimentation and worldwide rollout.
- Build performant, accessible and localized user interfaces that work consistently across web, desktop and mobile hosts, as well as SharePoint and OneDrive.
- Drive web performance through server-side rendering, hydration and rendering optimization, early data fetching, service workers and bundle-size reduction, with a focus on end-to-end latency and time to first answer.
- Integrate AI-generated answers into the search experience, including streaming responses, citations and source attribution, and graceful handling of partial or failed responses.
- Instrument features with telemetry, define success metrics, and run A/B experiments and staged rollouts to make data-driven product decisions.
- Own the reliability of the features you build, including monitoring, alerting, automated health checks and diagnosis of client issues such as authentication and host-loading failures.
- Participate in the team's on-call rotation, mitigating production incidents quickly and driving root-cause fixes so they do not recur.
- Partner closely with product managers, designers and backend search and relevance engineers to turn ambiguous ideas into polished, shippable experiences.
- Raise the engineering bar through thoughtful code reviews, automated testing and contributions to shared components and engineering practices.
- Use AI-assisted development tools and LLM-based techniques, such as automated analysis of user feedback and quality evaluation, to move faster and improve product quality.

Qualifications
Required/Minimum Qualifications:
- Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or related technical field AND 4+ years technical engineering experience with coding in languages including, but not limited to, C, C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, or Python.- OR equivalent experience.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Solid experience building production web applications with React and TypeScript.
- Solid web fundamentals: HTML, CSS, browser rendering, web performance and server-side rendering.
- Experience building and operating large-scale web applications used by a broad customer base.
- Experience with telemetry, A/B experimentation and data-driven decision making.
- Working knowledge of accessibility standards and building inclusive user interfaces.
- Experience building LLM or AI-powered product features, such as streaming experiences.
- Exposure to mobile or cross-platform hosts, such as web experiences embedded in apps.
- Experience with live-site operations, monitoring and on-call responsibilities.
- Familiarity with search or information retrieval concepts is a plus.
- Solid problem-solving and communication skills, and comfort collaborating across time zones.

Job Details

About Salesforce
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

About Salesforce
 
We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good– you’ve come to the right place.
 
Monitoring Cloud is seeking engineers to architect, implement, deliver and operate our observability services that run in the public cloud at massive scale.

Monitoring Cloud is an integral part of the Salesforce Infrastructure that provides key insights for all development teams to quickly detect and remediate incidents to ensure the highest availability of Salesforce products for our customers. This cloud owns the entire telemetry stack starting with the agents that emit, collect and ship telemetry to large-scale backend systems that store data and enable efficient and low-latency queries to provide valuable insights. We support all the key pillars of telemetry - metrics, logs, traces and events at massive scale. Our teams have built these services using a combination of open source technologies and home grown technologies, both of which were essential at Salesforce scale and this has been architected from the ground up to run efficiently in the public cloud.

We are looking to add engineers, with experience building and owning distributed services, who can step up and own big chunks of this vision on these projects. You’ll be challenged to blend customer-centric principles, industry-changing innovation, and the reliable delivery of new technologies. You will work directly with engineering, product, and design, to create experiences that reinforce the Salesforce brand by delighting and wowing our customers with highly reliable and available services.

Who are you

You are a high-performing hybrid engineer who thrives in a “Get it Done” environment. You take ownership of complex problems, independently delivering high-quality features while continuously driving engineering excellence.

- You proactively design, develop, and implement critical functionality, tackling features of increasing complexity with confidence.
- You are adaptable and eager to learn new technologies, solving ambiguous problems quickly to accelerate business impact.
- You take pride in your work, applying engineering best practices to build scalable, maintainable solutions.
- You are innovative, always looking for ways to improve services and are unafraid to propose new ideas.
- You are comfortable presenting your team’s work to peers, leadership, and broader engineering groups—whether in team meetings, leadership reviews, or Tech Talks.
- You write understandable, testable code with an eye towards maintainability.

If you’re someone who takes ownership, thrives on solving tough challenges, and enjoys driving impact, we’d love to hear from you!

Required Skills/Experiences

- B.S/M.S. in Computer Sciences or equivalent field with 6+ years of software development experience
- Experience building highly scalable, available, and real-time data management services
- Deep understanding and experience building services on the public cloud (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc)
- Strong experience developing services/software in a Linux/UNIX environment using Java/Python/Go
- Comfortable in a fast-paced environment focused on delivering production code at a regular cadence using Agile techniques, tools, and methodologies.
- Design, build, and maintain scalable API gateway services and edge proxies to handle ingress traffic for distributed microservices
- Implement advanced traffic routing, rate limiting, load balancing, circuit breaking, retries, and caching strategies.
- Deep knowledge of sizing OTEL collectors, handling backpressure, configuring memory limiters, and avoiding data drops during traffic spikes.
- Excellent written and verbal communication that helps collaborate effectively and efficiently in distributed scrum teams.
- Experience in building and managing services using IaaS constructs while ensuring 99.99% reliability in production.

- Hands-on experience with OpenTelemetry Collectors to ingest, process, and route logs, metrics, and distributed traces is a good to have

- Experience working with CI/CD technologies (such as Spinnaker), Docker and Terraform
- Experience with Spring, gRPC, REST and the HTTP protocol
- Familiarity with service mesh architectures (Istio, Linkerd) and how they interact with both the API Gateway and the OTEL ecosystem

Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: SDE II, EE Experiences, Progressive Discovery and Monetization
description:
Everyday Essentials (EE) is a $100B+ business and one of the fastest-growing categories at Amazon — the household staples, health and personal care, grocery, and beauty products hundreds of millions of customers reorder. We're reinventing how customers discover, buy, and get more value from them, and we're looking for Software Development Engineers who want to build that future.

The EE Experiences organization builds the shopping experience for the products customers come back for most. Our charter is Progressive Discovery and Monetization: helping customers find better products for their needs, complete their baskets, and improve EE business economics — and giving the world's largest consumer brands new and effective ways to reach those customers and grow with Amazon. We build a durable, profitable business at the intersection of the two, on the surfaces customers use every day.

This is a space where the hardest problems don't have off-the-shelf answers. We're not polishing a solved product — we're inventing experiences that don't exist yet, and the decisions we make now shape a business with room to grow for years. You'll build discovery and recommendation features, brand-facing advertising surfaces, and the backend services that power them. Your work moves from whiteboard to production in front of a very large customer base, with visibility all the way to senior leadership.

We're an AI-first team, and that shows up in two ways. We use AI throughout how we build software, and we expect our engineers to keep learning and applying the latest tools to move faster and raise the quality bar. AI is also at the core of what we build — the intelligence that helps customers find the right product is a modeling and engineering problem we work on hand in hand with scientists. If you're curious about AI, learn quickly, and like using it to solve real customer problems while keeping a clear head about where it helps and where it doesn't, you'll fit right in.

Key job responsibilities
Design, build, and own software end to end — from customer research through design, code, testing, deployment, and production operations.
Take on ambiguous problems where the goal is clear but the path is not, bring clarity, and deliver simple solutions that improve how customers find and buy everyday essentials.
Partner closely with scientists, product managers, and designers to turn customer and brand problems into products that ship worldwide.
Use generative AI tools and modern engineering practices to raise quality and velocity, and coach teammates on getting the most from them.
Own operational health for your services — monitor metrics, drive root-cause fixes, and keep improving the experience for customers and brand partners.
Raise the technical bar through code reviews, mentoring, and hiring for the best talent.

A day in the life
Most days start with the customer problem in front of you: how to help someone find better everyday-essentials products faster, or how to give brands a more effective way to reach shoppers or how to improve the profitability of the business. You dig into data, sketch a design, and talk it through with product managers and scientists before writing any code. By the afternoon you might be prototyping an idea that didn't exist yesterday, reviewing a teammate's change, or debugging something in production. Because so much here is new, you won't just pick up tickets. You'll help decide what to build, push for the approach you believe in, and see your work reach customers in weeks, not quarters.

About the team
Our team owns how customers discover and buy the everyday essentials they rely on — and how the brands behind those products reach them. Our mission is to make restocking the things you need effortless, help customers find better options and to improve the business economics along the way. Day to day you'll work with fellow engineers and partner closely with product managers, designers, and scientists, who bring the customer and data insight that shapes what we build. We're a small, fast-moving group solving open-ended problems for hundreds of millions of shoppers — a place where you own problems end to end and your ideas reach customers fast.

description:
Job Description Summary
This position involves understanding the design of components and developing them within an application or product. The role requires strong hands-on experience in development, preferably using Java, Spring Boot, and AWS cloud services. The candidate will collaborate with team members to understand and integrate these components within and across subsystems. Attention to detail is crucial to ensure non-functional requirements are met during implementation and testing, achieving the best possible performance, quality, and responsiveness of the applications as per product requirements.

GE HealthCare is a leading global medical technology and digital solutions innovator. Our purpose is to create a world where healthcare has no limits. Unlock your ambition, turn ideas into world-changing realities, and join an organization where every voice makes a difference, and every difference builds a healthier world.

Job Description
In this role you will be responsible for 
Cloud Design & Implementation:
- Low level design, develop, and deploy cloud-based solutions using AWS services such as EC2, S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, EventBridge.
- Implement IoT solutions utilizing AWS IoT Core, Greengrass, and other relevant AWS IoT services.
- Develop, deploy and test microservices using ECS/EKS-based containerized applications using Docker and ECS/EKS and Lambda.
- Develop and maintain backend services and microservices using Java and Spring Boot and test using Python BDD.
- Maintain code quality through best practices, unit testing and test automation.
- Participate in software design reviews, conduct code reviews and peer testing for other members in the team

Infrastructure as Code (IaC):

- Monitor and optimize cloud-based systems for performance, scalability, and security.
- Troubleshoot and resolve complex cloud infrastructure and Java application issues.

Collaboration & Documentation:
- Work closely with internal and external teams to ensure cloud solutions meet business requirements.
- Create and maintain detailed documentation including low level designs, deployment scripts, troubleshooting guides and operational procedures.

Security & Compliance:
- Basic knowledge of security practices in healthcare (nice to have)
- Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements.

Continuous Improvement:
- Stay updated with the latest advancements in AWS, IoT, ECS/EKS, IaC, and Java/Python technologies.
- Proactively suggest improvements and enhancements to existing systems and processes.

Mentorship & Guidance:
- Demonstrates the ability to excel both as an individual contributor and as a collaborative team player.
- Foster a collaborative and inclusive team environment, encouraging continuous learning and professional growth.

Education Qualification
Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or “STEM” Majors (Science, Technology, Engineering and Math) with minimum 3+ years of experience in cloud engineering with a focus on Java, Python, AWS, Kubernetes/ECS, CI/CD.

Experience:
- Hands-on experience with AWS services (EKS, S3, Lambda, DynamoDB, SQS, CloudWatch) and good to have IoT technologies (AWS IoT Core).
- Working knowledge of in ECS/Kubernetes, Docker, SQL and NO-SQL databases.
- Good to have knowledge on UI/UX with Javascript, Angular, React technologies

Business Acumen:
- Comfortable working within a team structure and collaborating with colleagues to overcome challenges and achieve goals.
- Capable of understanding/communicating the importance of key business/customer objectives.
- Able to provide clear and concise information for team use, with some experience in presentations and storytelling.

Leadership:
- Able to identify challenges and collaborate with team members to find solutions and leverage resources.
- Demonstrated ability to work with blended teams, including 3rd party partners and customer personnel.
- Demonstrated Change Management /Acceleration capabilities
- Strong interpersonal skills, including creativity and curiosity with ability to effectively communicate and influence across all organizational levels
- Proven analytical and problem resolution skills
- Effective communication and collaboration skills, with experience working closely with cross-functional teams.

title: Senior Consultant - Full Stack Apps
description:
Overview

Microsoft Industry Solutions Delivery (ISD) is a global organization hosting over 6,000 strategic sellers, industry and security experts, elite engineers, world-class data scientists and architects, consultants, and delivery specialists. Together with our partners, we help Microsoft’s most strategic customers worldwide to address their specific challenges and provide comprehensive and industry-specific solutions that meet their unique needs. ISD is at the forefront of innovation, driving value across the entirety of the customers’ digital and AI transformation journey through repeatable and customized cutting-edge solutions through strategic engagements with customers across the globe powered by Microsoft Cloud and AI.

Responsibilities

- Lead the technical delivery of complex, cloud‑native and AI‑enabled engagements, contributing as a hands‑on individual contributor and, where required, leading engineering teams to ensure high‑quality, predictable outcomes. 
- Define and drive the technology strategy for large and complex customer engagements, ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned to business objectives, architectural best practices, and Microsoft reference architectures. 
- Design, develop, and deploy solutions on Microsoft Azure, accelerating customer value through the effective use of Microsoft technologies, platforms, and delivery methodologies. 
- Applies user‑centered design principles to translate customer needs into clear technical requirements and scalable solution designs through iterative prototyping and feedback. 
- Provide delivery leadership by setting technical priorities, estimating effort, managing dependencies, making disciplined trade‑offs, and driving successful releases. 
- Ensure engineering excellence and solution quality, with accountability for the overall efficacy, performance, security, and compliance of technical delivery within assigned engagements. 
- Identify, assess, and manage technical risks and dependencies across projects, including defining mitigation strategies, handling escalations, and planning for both short‑ and long‑term delivery risks. 
- Apply information security, compliance, and assurance standards to maintain stakeholder confidence and meet customer, regulatory, and Microsoft governance requirements. 
- Drive innovation and digital transformation, leveraging existing intellectual property (IP), reusable assets, and best practices to improve delivery predictability and speed. 
- Collaborate with cross‑functional teams, including Sales, account‑aligned teams, and peers, to articulate technical value propositions and support the expansion and adoption of Microsoft cloud and AI solutions with strategic customers. 
- Contribute to thought leadership and continuous improvement, fostering new ways of working that enhance engineering productivity, solution quality, and responsiveness to evolving customer needs.

Qualifications

- 10+ years of overall professional experience in software engineering, application development, and solution delivery, with a strong focus on enterprise‑scale, customer‑facing engagements. 
- 5+ years of experience in customer‑facing delivery leadership 
- Bachelor's degree in computer science engineering, or a related field. Advanced or higher‑education qualifications are a plus. 
- Microsoft and cloud technology certifications are preferred, including but not limited to: AZ‑204 (Developing Solutions for Microsoft Azure), AI‑102 (Designing and Implementing an Azure AI Solution), MCSD / MCSE or equivalent modern cloud and AI certifications. 

AREAS OF EXPERTISE 

Full‑Stack Application Development

- Strong experience designing, building, and deploying business‑ and mission‑critical applications using .NET (C#), .NET Web APIs, Node.js. 
- Full‑stack development expertise across UI, API, service, domain, data, and integration layers, with proficiency in C#, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular or React, HTML5, and CSS/SCSS. 
- Deep understanding of software architecture patterns and anti‑patterns for large‑scale systems, including MVC, CQRS, and Saga, with a focus on performance, scalability, and resiliency. 
- Excellent foundation in software engineering principles, data structures, algorithms, testing, debugging, and analytical problem‑solving. 
- Proficiency with cloud data platforms including Azure SQL, Cosmos DB, Azure Database for PostgreSQL, MySQL, Azure SQL Managed Instance, and MariaDB. 
- Experience creating reusable application frameworks and shared components that address cross‑cutting concerns such as logging, security, resiliency, and configuration management. 
- Hands‑on experience with multi‑threaded and parallel programming and high‑throughput service design. 

AI Application Development & Generative AI

- Strong hands‑on experience, preferably with Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Cognitive Search, Vector Search, and Retrieval‑Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns. 
- Proven expertise in building enterprise‑grade LLM and agentic AI solutions using Semantic Kernel, LangChain, LangGraph, AutoGen, and developer copilots such as GitHub Copilot and Cursor. 
- Practical experience in prompt engineering, prompt optimization, evaluation frameworks, and reliability tuning to deliver safe, high‑quality AI outputs. 
- Advanced Python expertise in implementing RAG pipelines, vector workflows, agent orchestration, and AI evaluation frameworks. 
- Strong understanding and application of Responsible AI principles, including safety, fairness, transparency, and governance (mandatory). 

Cloud Architecture, Platforms & DevOps

- Extensive experience in designing, implementing, operating, tuning, and troubleshooting large‑scale cloud solutions on Microsoft Azure or any public cloud. 
- Hands‑on expertise implementing microservices and serverless architectures using Kubernetes, Azure Functions, Service Fabric, and related platforms. 
- Strong experience defining and implementing CI/CD pipelines, automated testing, and release strategies including Blue/Green and Canary deployments. 
- Deep experience with cloud monitoring and end‑to‑end telemetry, ensuring observability, reliability, and production readiness. 

Security, Compliance & Zero Trust

- Strong expertise in security‑by‑design principles, including encryption, authentication and authorization (AuthN/AuthZ). 
- Deep knowledge of Zero Trust architecture, IAM, secure‑by‑default design, threat modeling, compliance standards, and DevSecOps practices. 
- Hands‑on experience with least‑privilege access, assume‑breach concepts, micro‑segmentation, continuous monitoring, SAST/DAST, and secure CI/CD pipelines. 
- Familiarity with security and monitoring tools such as Microsoft Defender for Cloud, Microsoft Threat Modeling Tool, Azure Sentinel, and Splunk. 

Consulting, Transformation & Industry Experience

Proven experience delivering large‑scale digital transformation initiatives, including cloud migration and hybrid modernization programs. Brings architectural breadth through exposure to open‑source technologies and platforms. Has good exposure to Azure/AWS/GCP, along with industry experience across domains such as financial services, government, healthcare, manufacturing, and retail/supply chain.

Good to have

Customer Co-Innovation Mindset & Customer Enablement

- Lead rapid prototyping, pilots, and early-stage production deployments for enterprise customers, accelerating time-to-value 
- Translate from whiteboard to production with minimal friction, engineering alongside customer teams to unblock delivery and adoption 
- Own troubleshooting across performance, reliability, cost, security, and data quality, delivering outcome-driven engineering in ambiguous, high-pressure environments 

Other 

- Embody our culture and values 

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. title: Senior Engineer Frontend, Monetization
description:
Who Are We?

Postman is the world’s leading API platform, used by more than 45 million+ developers and 500,000 organizations, including 98% of the Fortune 500. Postman is helping developers and professionals across the globe build the API-first world by simplifying each step of the API lifecycle and streamlining collaboration—enabling users to create better APIs, faster.

The company is headquartered in San Francisco and has offices in Boston, New York, Austin, Tokyo, London, and Bangalore - where Postman was founded. Postman is privately held, with funding from Battery Ventures, BOND, Coatue, CRV, Insight Partners, and Nexus Venture Partners. Learn more at postman.com or connect with Postman on X via @getpostman.

P.S: We highly recommend reading The "API-First World" graphic novel to understand the bigger picture and our vision at Postman.

The Opportunity

The Monetization Team powers Postman pricing & packaging, and scales its business.

We Build And Operate Mission-critical Billing Systems That Handle

- Payments & renewals
- Subscription lifecycle
- Sales, tax & compliance
- Revenue systems
- Post Purchase product onboarding 

As Postman grows, we are evolving towards a config-driven, highly scalable platform that supports both self-serve and sales-led motions globally.

We’re looking for a Front End Senior Engineer who can lead the development of the user-facing platform, driving technical excellence in UI architecture and product innovation in the monetization experience.

What You'll Do

- Build & Optimize Monetization Experiences Design, develop, and own the user interfaces for key monetization flows, including checkout, subscription management, and pricing pages.
- Drive UI Architecture and Performance Establish and enforce best practices for front-end architecture, ensuring high performance, scalability, and maintainability across all user-facing features.
- Implement Config-Driven UIs Develop reusable UI components and systems to dynamically render pricing, packaging, and configuration settings driven by backend services.
- Enhance Admin and Sales Workflows Build and improve internal-facing applications (Admin UIs) to enable sales, finance, and support teams to manage custom contracts, discounts, and user subscriptions efficiently
- Collaborate Cross-Functionally Partner with Product, Design, Support, Security, and Platform teams to deliver impactful solutions and ensure a consistent user experience.
- Raise the Engineering Bar Conduct thorough code reviews, define front-end best practices, mentor engineers, and influence decisions on UI technology stack and tooling.

About You

- 6+ years of experience designing and building complex, high-traffic web applications.
- Strong proficiency in:
- Modern JavaScript/TypeScript and one or more leading front-end frameworks (e.g., React, Node.js, Angular).
- Advanced state management techniques and architectural patterns for large-scale single-page applications (SPAs).
- Deep expertise in:
- Front-end performance optimization (e.g., bundle size, critical rendering path, load times).
- Cross-browser compatibility and accessibility (WCAG standards).
- Integrating and consuming RESTful and/or GraphQL APIs efficiently.
- Hands-on experience with:
- Unit, Integration, and End-to-End testing frameworks
- Bundling and building tools.
- CI/CD pipelines for front-end deployments.
- Proven track record of:
- Translating complex design mockups into high-fidelity, responsive user interfaces.
- Leading technical design and implementation of major front-end features.
- Strong collaboration skills, comfortable working with and challenging PMs, EMs, and stakeholders.
- (Bonus) Experience with A/B testing frameworks and deep understanding of user experience principles in high-stakes transaction flows (e.g., checkout, billing portals)

What Else?

In addition to Postman's pay-on-performance philosophy, and a flexible schedule working with a fun, collaborative team, Postman offers a comprehensive set of benefits, including full medical coverage, flexible PTO, wellness reimbursement, and a monthly lunch stipend. Along with that, our wellness programs will help you stay in the best of your physical and mental health. Our frequent and fascinating team-building events will keep you connected, while our donation-matching program can support the causes you care about. We’re building a long-term company with an inclusive culture where everyone can be the best version of themselves.

At Postman we value in person collaboration. We are in office 5 days a week for all roles based out of our hubs in San Francisco Bay Area, Boston, Austin, New York City, Tokyo and London. For roles based in Bangalore, employees currently work in the office three days a week and will transition to five days per week by the end of the year. We were thoughtful in our approach which is based on collaboration and grounded in feedback from our workforce, leadership team, and peers. The benefits of our in office model will be shared knowledge, brainstorming sessions, communication, and building trust in-person that cannot be replicated via zoom.

Our Values

At Postman, we create with the same curiosity that we see in our users. We value transparency and honest communication about not only successes, but also failures. In our work, we focus on specific goals that add up to a larger vision. Our inclusive work culture ensures that everyone is valued equally as important pieces of our final product. We are dedicated to delivering the best products we can.

Equal Opportunity

Postman is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. Headhunters and recruitment agencies may not submit resumes/CVs through this website or directly to managers. Postman does not accept unsolicited headhunter and agency resumes. Postman will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company that does not have a signed agreement with Postman.

title: Senior Full-stack Engineer - (Cloud, AI)
description:
TechGrove is the Centre of Excellence for Banyan Software, based in Chennai, India. It plays a key role in supporting Banyan’s global businesses through technology, security, and software development. TechGrove brings together India’s deep pool of technical talent with Banyan’s long-term approach to growth, creating a trusted, developer-focused environment where people can do their best work.
 Senior Full-stack Engineer - (AI, Cloud)
TechGrove AI Engineering Pod
You are a versatile, senior full-stack engineer who likes to own a feature from the database all the way to the pixel, and you ship. You are fluent across the stack, comfortable in the cloud, and you have leaned into AI-native development as a way to move faster without cutting corners. You take pride in clean, well-tested, production-quality code.
As a Senior Full-stack Engineer (Cloud), you are the delivery muscle of the pod. You build modernized, cloud-native applications end to end: cloud services and data, robust APIs, and modern, responsive user interfaces aligned to the OpCo’s design system. You develop natively with agentic tooling such as Claude Code, and you help set the standard for how the pod uses it.
If you want to build real products with senior peers, with AI woven through your daily workflow, this is the team.
About the PodA TechGrove AI Engineering Pod is a self-contained, AI-native software delivery team that we embed inside one of our Operating Companies (OpCos) to build, modernize, and ship production software. Each pod pairs senior engineering talent with agentic AI tooling such as Claude Code, plus the accelerators of Banyan’s AI Application Modernization Factory, to deliver at a velocity and quality bar a traditional team cannot match.
A pod is typically four to eight people, and OpCos add more pods as their ambitions grow. You will work as part of a tight, high-trust team with real ownership of what you build. Pods are delivered from Banyan’s India-based TechGrove.
What You Will Do- Deliver full-stack features: Own complex features end to end: backend services, APIs, data, and UI, writing clean, well-tested, production-quality code.
- Build great frontends: Build responsive, accessible interfaces in React.js and Next.js, implementing against the OpCo’s design system and shared component library for visual and behavioral consistency.
- Engineer for the cloud: Design and build scalable, secure, resilient applications on cloud-native infrastructure.
- Design APIs and data: Build robust APIs (REST and GraphQL) and well-designed SQL/No-SQL data models supporting microservices and cloud-native patterns.
- Develop AI-natively: Use and champion AI-assisted development tooling (Claude Code and similar) to maximize velocity and code quality across the SDLC.
- Own delivery and DevSecOps: Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) for rapid, reliable, secure deployments.
- Raise quality through reviews: Participate in and lead code reviews, including of AI-generated code, upholding design patterns (DDD), testing, and application-security standards.
- Integrate and modernize: Implement integration patterns connecting new services with the OpCo’s existing systems as part of modernization and re-platforming.
- Own it in production: Take ownership through deployment and operation, contributing to observability, performance, and reliability.
What You Bring- Experience: Strong software engineering experience building production applications.
- Production experience on AWS or Azure (required): You have built and run production applications on AWS or Azure. Experience limited to GCP alone does not meet this requirement, although GCP in addition to AWS or Azure is a plus.
- Full-stack ability: Strong proficiency across the stack: modern backend languages and modern UI frameworks (React.js, Next.js, Vite).
- Modern tech stack: Strong, hands-on experience with at least one of: .NET Core, Python, TypeScript, or Java.
- Frontend and design systems: Solid hands-on React.js experience: building responsive, accessible UIs from reusable components, managing client-side state, and working within an established design system and component library.
- APIs and data: Hands-on experience designing APIs (REST and/or GraphQL) and working with SQL and No-SQL databases.
- IaC and DevSecOps: Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform) and building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI).
- AI-native tooling: Fluency with AI-assisted development tooling (Claude Code or similar) as a core part of daily work.
- Engineering principles: Solid grounding in DDD, clean code, SOLID and DRY, test-driven development, strong typing, and code hygiene.
- Problem solving: Structured technical problem-solving (decomposition, hypothesis-driven testing) to debug complex issues in distributed systems.
- Agile and ownership: Experience working in Agile (Scrum/Kanban) with a proactive ownership mindset.
Nice to Have- Containerization (Docker/Kubernetes) and serverless (AWS Lambda, Azure Functions).
- Experience developing GenAI capabilities (LangChain, LlamaIndex) or multi-agent frameworks (crewAI, AutoGen).
- Message queuing and streaming technologies (Kafka, RabbitMQ).
- Experience with SaaS operating models and observability / APM tooling.
- Experience with application modernization or re-platforming.
- Working knowledge of GCP, in addition to AWS or Azure.
What Success Looks Like- First 90 days: You are shipping production features independently, your code sets a clean example for the pod, and you are using agentic tooling fluently in your daily workflow.
- First 6 months: You are trusted with complex, cross-cutting features, you raise quality through reviews and patterns, and you are a dependable engine of the pod’s delivery.
Why TechGrove, Why Banyan- Permanent home, long-term thinking: Banyan acquires great software businesses and keeps them for good. We invest for the long term, which means you build software meant to last, not to flip.
- Real ownership: You own outcomes end to end inside a small, senior team. The OpCo owns the “what”; the pod owns the “how.”
- AI-native by default: You work every day with agentic tooling and the AI Application Modernization Factory, not as a side experiment but as the core of how we build.
- Variety with stability: Pods work across a portfolio of real products and domains, so you keep learning, with the security of a permanent employer behind you.
- Growth and excellence: A Banyan Director of Engineering Excellence supports every pod with coaching, standards, and continuous improvement, so your craft compounds over time.
Should You Apply?We have written this role to be honest about what it takes, not to describe a mythical perfect candidate. If you meet most of what is listed and you are excited by the work, we want to hear from you. Strong engineers grow into the rest, and we will help you do exactly that.
We are building diverse, inclusive teams, and we welcome applicants of every background. What matters most is the quality of your engineering, your curiosity about AI-native development, and your appetite to own outcomes.
 
Beware of Recruitment Scams
We have been made aware of individuals fraudulently posing as members of our Talent Acquisition team and extending fake job offers. These scams may involve requests for personal information or payment for equipment. 
Protect yourself by following these steps:
- Verify that all communications from our recruiting team come from an @banyansoftware.com email address.
- Remember, employers will never request payment or banking information during the hiring process.
- If you receive a suspicious message, do not respond — instead, forward it to careers@banyansoftware.com and/or report it to the platform where you received it.
Your safety and security are important to us. Thank you for staying vigilant.

About TRADL AI

TRADL AI is building India's first AI trading co-pilot for 100M+ traders.

Today, we convert natural language into verified, code-backed stock intelligence - no hallucinations, no black boxes. Tomorrow, we're building the full stack: real-time chart intelligence, autonomous research agents, and portfolio-aware execution. We're turning what institutional desks spend millions on into a conversation anyone can have. We're live, growing fast, and the hardest technical problems are still ahead of us.

We're live, growing fast, and the hardest technical problems are still ahead of us.

We are building the engineering team that will scale this from hundreds to hundreds of thousands of concurrent traders.

Why This Role Exists

Trading interfaces have zero margin for latency, rendering errors, or unreliable data. Traders spend six hours a day inside it. This role owns the entire web frontend. You set the architectural foundation for how every page is built, how state flows, how data streams, and how the UI holds up under load. All of it is data-dense, real-time, and unforgiving of sloppy implementation.

What You'll Own

- Core Trading Workspace: Market Overview, Stock Page, Option Chain, Strategy Builder, Backtesting, Portfolio, Trade Journal, Watchlist. Data-heavy, real-time, performance-critical.
- Dashboard & Widget System: A FlexLayout-powered workspace with live, draggable, resizable widgets. Traders build their own decision cockpit.
- AI Interaction UX: The natural language query interface - conversational UI, streaming responses, data visualization widgets that render instantly as AI computes.
- Real-Time Data Layer: WebSocket integration for live market data, portfolio updates, alert triggers, and AI response streaming.
- Design System: Build TRADL's frontend design system from scratch (option chains, order books, payoff diagrams, responsive layouts).
Performance Engineering: Virtual scrolling for AG Grid tables with thousands of rows. Core Web Vitals targets: 

What We're Looking For

- 4–6 years in frontend engineering with React + TypeScript as primary stack.
- 3+ years at a startup - you've shipped under pressure, owned features end to end, and dealt with the mess of moving fast.
- Real-time data visualization experience. You've built dashboards that update at sub-second intervals without frame drops.
- State management at scale - Zustand, Redux, or Jotai. You know when to reach for which and why.
- TanStack Query for server state. WebSocket integration experience, reconnection logic, subscription management, binary data parsing.
- AG Grid or equivalent data grid experience.

Bonus Points

- FlexLayout, react-grid-layout, or experience building draggable dashboard systems
- Plotly.js or complex data visualization libraries
- Performance optimization for data-heavy UIs at production scale
- Experience building trading terminals or analytical interfaces

title: Software Engineer II
description:
Position Overview

We are looking for a Software Engineer, Revenue Cycle Management AI Automation & Platform to help build the next generation of Experity’s RCM technology.

In this role, you will design, develop, deploy, and operate production-grade software that supports critical healthcare revenue cycle workflows. You will work primarily across backend services, APIs, integrations, event-driven and long-running workflows, configurable business rules, and data, supporting areas such as charge entry, claims processing, claim submission, rejection and denial resolution, payments, and other parts of the revenue cycle.

You will work closely with Product Managers, RCM Operations, Software Engineers, Architects, Data teams, and QA to translate complex healthcare business workflows into scalable, maintainable software solutions.

This is a product engineering role where success means more than delivering features. You will help increase automation, reduce unnecessary manual work, improve claim outcomes, shorten processing time, and build an RCM platform that can continue to evolve.

You will be expected to understand the business workflow behind the software you build, identify opportunities for automation, and use deterministic software, configurable rules, data, and AI agent based on what is most appropriate for the problem.

What You’ll Do

- Design, develop, test, deploy, and operate scalable production software supporting Experity’s Revenue Cycle Management workflows.
- Build backend services and REST APIs using TypeScript, Node.js, and cloud-native technologies.
- Contribute to modern web applications when needed using technologies such as React, Next.js, and TypeScript.
- Design and implement event-driven, queue-based, and asynchronous workflows with explicit state management, retries, redrive, exception handling, idempotency, and auditability.
- Design long-running RCM workflows that support state transitions, human-in-the-loop processing, exception handling, replay/recovery, workflow versioning, and compensation or reversal when appropriate.
- Build integrations with Experity applications, healthcare clearinghouses, payer systems, and third-party RCM services.
- Design reliable interfaces for claims, payment, eligibility, rejection, denial, and other healthcare transaction workflows.
- Develop configurable business rules and workflow capabilities that replace logic currently distributed across application code, spreadsheets, and operational processes.
- Build rules and workflow capabilities that are configurable, versioned, explainable, auditable, and safe to change without introducing unnecessary application dependencies.
- Work with claims, financial, and operational data to improve automation, identify exceptions, and measure business outcomes.
- Integrate Generative AI, LLMs, agents, retrieval, and machine learning capabilities where they provide measurable value, while using deterministic software and business rules where those approaches are more appropriate.
- Build AI-enabled capabilities using clearly defined tools, APIs, contracts, permissions, validation, evaluation, observability, and fallback paths rather than treating LLMs as standalone solutions.
- Use modern AI-assisted software development practices for codebase exploration, development, testing, debugging, documentation, and engineering productivity while maintaining appropriate engineering review and quality standards.
- Build observability, automated testing, security, operational controls, and failure recovery into software from the beginning.
- Design systems with healthcare security, PHI protection, least-privilege access, auditability, and safe operational logging in mind.
- Contribute to architecture, technical design, engineering standards, and platform evolution.
- Collaborate with Product, RCM Operations, Architecture, Data, QA, and other engineering teams to understand real-world workflows and translate them into reliable software.
- Investigate production issues using application behavior, logs, metrics, data, and user workflows.
- Own software through production and continuously improve it based on system behavior, operational feedback, and business results.
- Measure the impact of engineering improvements through outcomes such as automation rate, exception rate, manual touches, processing time, rejection/denial resolution time, successful resubmission, payment outcomes, and system reliability.

Qualifications

Required

- 3+ years of professional software engineering experience building and supporting production applications.
- Strong software engineering fundamentals, including application design, testing, debugging, code review, and maintainability.
- Experience building backend services, REST APIs, and distributed applications.
- Proficiency with TypeScript, Node.js, or comparable modern backend technologies.
- Experience with modern web development technologies such as React, Next.js, or similar frameworks.
- Experience with relational databases, SQL, data modeling, and transactional systems.
- Experience developing and operating cloud-hosted applications, preferably on AWS.
- Understanding of asynchronous processing, queues, events, retries, idempotency, and distributed-system failure modes.
- Experience with automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, observability, and secure software development practices.
- Ability to break complex business workflows into well-defined software components, services, and contracts.
- Ability to investigate ambiguous problems and develop solutions using production behavior, data, logs, and user workflows rather than relying only on predefined requirements.
- Strong collaboration and communication skills with the ability to work across engineering, product, operations, architecture, and data teams.

Preferred

Experience in one or more of the following areas is valuable but not required:

- Healthcare Revenue Cycle Management, medical billing, claims, rejections, denials, eligibility, or payment processing.
- Healthcare, HealthTech, or SaaS environments.
- Waystar or other healthcare clearinghouse integrations.
- High-volume transaction or workflow-processing systems.
- Event-driven architectures and distributed systems.
- Modernizing legacy systems incrementally while maintaining production continuity.
- Configurable rules engines, workflow orchestration systems, or exception-management platforms.
- Production use of Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, or machine learning.
- AI orchestration frameworks, structured tool use, MCP or similar tool protocols, and agentic workflows.
- Build human-in-the-loop automation where AI or software recommendations require review, approval, correction, or escalation.
- Snowflake or other cloud-native data platforms.
- Docker, Kubernetes, and containerized application deployment.
- Data-intensive application development and distributed data processing.

Technology Environment

Our RCM Engineering Environment Includes

- Backend: TypeScript, Node.js, Python
- Frontend: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Cloud & Platform: AWS, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD
- Architecture: REST APIs, queues, events, asynchronous workflows, distributed services
- Data: SQL, Snowflake, Tableau
- AI: AWS Bedrock, LLM APIs, retrieval, structured tool use, Generative AI, and agentic workflows
- Integrations: Waystar, Experity EMR and Practice Management, payer systems, and third-party RCM services

Candidates are not expected to have experience with every technology listed above. Strong engineering fundamentals, relevant production experience, and the ability to learn new technologies and domains are more important than matching every item in the stack.

How We Work

We want engineers who understand the problem they are solving, not just the ticket they are implementing.

You should be comfortable learning a complex healthcare domain, questioning existing processes, working through ambiguity, making practical technical tradeoffs, and taking ownership of the software you build.

Our engineers collaborate closely with business and operational teams because understanding the real workflow is essential to building the right solution. We value pragmatic engineering, measurable outcomes, incremental modernization, and choosing the right technology for the problem rather than applying technology for its own sake.

We expect engineers to think beyond individual features: understand the end-to-end RCM workflow, identify where AI and automation can eliminate unnecessary work, design for exceptions and failure from the beginning, and measure whether the software actually improves operational and financial outcomes.

We are also building an AI-native engineering culture. Engineers are expected to use modern AI development tools thoughtfully to accelerate delivery and improve quality while retaining ownership of architecture, code quality, testing, security, and production outcomes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Staff Software Engineer
description:

Someone who independently determines methods and approach on new, complex assignments, and who is sought out by other engineers for technical guidance beyond your own team. Your Experience Includes

Bonus Points For

Where we Work

Benefits

Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.

Resources

- @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data

You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. Our Commitment to You

When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. What you have

- Strong hands-on expertise in Java and Spring Boot for building production microservices
- Proficiency in Python and/or Node.js for backend service development
- Deep experience with AWS cloud services — ECS, RDS, SQS, SNS, S3, IAM, CloudWatch, Secrets Manager

- Experience with containerization and orchestration (Docker, ECS/Kubernetes)
- Strong grasp of system design, scalability, and distributed systems principles
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices (GitHub Actions or similar)

Nice to Have

- Experience with API gateways/service mesh (Envoy Proxy)

- Opportunity to shape technical direction and mentor a growing engineering team

What you will do 

Internal platform
- Build and maintain internal AI tools and automations, from scoping with the teams who need them through deployment, adoption tracking and iteration
- Design retrieval systems over the agency's past projects, proposals, case studies and creative work
- Build AI-assisted authoring for briefs, estimates, scopes of work, status reports and recaps

- Automate handoffs between project management, time tracking, Google Workspace, HR and finance systems

Client delivery

- Support new business with working prototypes and act as the technical voice in pitches, RFPs and scoping

What we are looking for
- 8+ years of software development experience
- 3+ years building generative AI systems that reached production with substantial user adoption
- Hands-on agentic systems work with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, CrewAI, Strands, Claude SDK or OpenAI Agents SDK, including orchestrator and multi-agent patterns, tool use via MCP, and state persistence

- Guardrails for generated content, including brand or compliance review and human-in-the-loop design
- Security and privacy practice for AI systems handling sensitive data
- Automated testing for agentic systems
- Ability to explain complex ideas to non-technical colleagues, from account teams to creative directors
- Comfort with ambiguity and imperfect, fragmented data

Good to have

- Experience building internal tools for a services business
- Leading or mentoring peers
- Client-facing or consulting experience, including RFP responses
- Familiarity with agency operations systems (project management, time tracking, finance, HR)

Agent Workstream Orchestration:
- Run single or paired agent workstreams across coding, test generation, and documentation workflows.
- Translate technical and product specifications into precise, structured instructions for AI agents to execute.

Operational Support and Issue Resolution:

- Capability Progression: Demonstrated growth in independent review judgement, prompt engineering literacy, and agent orchestration.
- Artefact Currency: High accuracy and completeness of shared context repositories and technical documentation contributed to the pod.
- Operational Resilience: Timely response to and resolution of domain incidents, maintaining reliable and secure platform performance.
- Demonstrates behaviours aligned to Officeworks’ values, contributing to a respectful, inclusive and high-performing culture.

- Operates in line with applicable Officeworks company policies and Code of Conduct
- Demonstrates a strong sense of personal accountability and curiosity to learn and develop

title: Junior Backend Engineer
description:
About TRADL AI

TRADL AI is building India's first AI trading co-pilot for 100M+ traders.

Today, we convert natural language into verified, code-backed stock intelligence - no hallucinations, no black boxes. Tomorrow, we're building the full stack: real-time chart intelligence, autonomous research agents, and portfolio-aware execution. We're turning what institutional desks spend millions on into a conversation anyone can have. We're live, growing fast, and the hardest technical problems are still ahead of us.

Our tech stack spans real-time market data ingestion (Kafka + TimescaleDB processing millions of ticks/day), AI/ML infrastructure (custom LLM orchestration + quant computation engines), a React/Next.js web platform, and native mobile apps - all built for sub-100ms latency because in trading, milliseconds matter.

We are building the engineering team that will scale this from hundreds to hundreds of thousands of concurrent traders.

Why This Role Exists

Every AI response, every live market feed, every trade execution, and every portfolio calculation runs through TRADL's backend. During market hours, the system must handle thousands of concurrent WebSocket connections, serve sub-100ms API responses, and maintain zero-downtime reliability. Traders are making real-money decisions on this infrastructure. This role owns the backend platform architecture, from real-time data pipelines to AI/ML serving and quantitative computation, and serves as the technical anchor for the engineering team.

What You'll Own

- API Platform: Design and build the REST + WebSocket API layer that serves the web app, mobile apps, and future third-party integrations. Rate limiting, authentication (OAuth 2.0 + broker SSO), caching, versioning, and documentation.
- Broking Platform Core: Native order management system with full execution stack. Order placement, position sync, holdings management, margin calculation, and risk controls. Built as a unified platform layer, not a third-party broker abstraction.
- Decompose the monolith into domain-bounded microservices: User Service, Query Engine, Market Data Service, Portfolio Service, Alert Service.
- Real-Time Infrastructure: WebSocket gateway for live data streaming to clients. Manage 10K+ concurrent connections, handle reconnection logic, and implement efficient subscription management.
- DevOps & Reliability: AWS EKS (Kubernetes) orchestration, CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions), auto-scaling policies, and incident response.

What We're Looking For

- 3-5 years in backend engineering with expertise in GoLang, C++, Rust or Java.
- Distributed systems experience: microservices, event-driven architecture, message queues, eventual consistency.
- Database design: PostgreSQL (primary), Redis (caching + pub/sub), and time-series workloads.
- Kubernetes + Docker in production. You've managed EKS/GKE clusters, written Helm charts, and configured auto-scaling policies.
- API design philosophy. You care about consistent response formats, proper HTTP semantics, pagination patterns, and error handling.

Bonus Points

- Experience with broker/trading platform APIs - order lifecycle, market data WebSockets, position management.
- WebSocket expertise at scale (10K+ concurrent connections, efficient pub/sub routing).
- You've built fintech systems handling real money - payments, wallets, or trading platforms.
