Your Location:

This position is India - Remote (Eligible anywhere within India). The role may include occasional work at an Airbnb office or attendance at offsites, as agreed to with your manager.

Our Commitment To Inclusion & Belonging

Airbnb is committed to working with the broadest talent pool possible. We believe diverse ideas foster innovation and engagement, and allow us to attract creatively-led people, and to develop the best products, services and solutions. All qualified individuals are encouraged to apply.

Reasonable Accommodations: We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the recruitment process for applicants with disabilities. If you need assistance, or an accommodation, please let your recruiter know once you are contacted about a role.

A Note on Recruiting Scams: Scammers sometimes pose as Airbnb recruiters to get money or personal information from candidates. A few things that will always be true for Airbnb’s hiring process: our open roles are posted on Airbnb’s Career’s Page at careers.airbnb.com, and our recruiters correspond only from @airbnb.com or @ext.airbnb.com email addresses. Our recruiters will never ask for your Social Security number, bank account details, passport, or payment app information while you are interviewing. We’ll also never ask you to pay a fee, send money, deposit or cash a check, or purchase work-related equipment (such as a company laptop) during the interview process. We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

title: Member of Technical Staff- Front End
description:
Join us as we work to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Position Summary

Build shared front-end platforms and AI-assisted developer tooling that help athenahealth engineering teams deliver reliable, accessible healthcare experiences. The Member of Technical Staff will develop and maintain frameworks, libraries, templates, and agent-driven workflows using TypeScript and React. This Bengaluru-based hybrid role will collaborate with engineers, product managers, and platform partners to deliver scalable, secure, and maintainable solutions.

About The Team

The Front End Frameworks team creates the shared foundations used to build and modernize front-end applications across athenahealth. Our work includes React and TypeScript standards, reusable libraries, build and migration tooling, continuous delivery practices, and responsible adoption of AI agents and Model Context Protocol integrations. We focus on making shared capabilities secure, accessible, dependable, and easy for product teams to adopt.

Essential Job Responsibilities

- Develop and maintain shared front-end frameworks, libraries, components, templates, and developer tooling using TypeScript and React.
- Build reusable platform capabilities and migration tooling that help teams modernize applications while preserving product behavior.
- Create agent-driven development workflows, reusable agent skills, and tool integrations for code understanding, modernization, test generation, documentation, and failure triage.
- Build or integrate Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients and servers that connect AI agents to approved engineering tools and information sources.
- Write automated tests, AI evaluations, guardrails, and monitoring that make shared software and agent workflows dependable and safe to use.
- Collaborate with engineers, product partners, user experience specialists, quality engineers, and platform teams to translate developer needs into practical solutions.
- Troubleshoot performance, accessibility, compatibility, and security issues; contribute to code reviews and carefully validate AI-generated output.

Additional Job Responsibilities

- Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, estimation, and iterative delivery.
- Document technical designs, platform contracts, examples, migration guidance, and tool dependencies.
- Support deployments, release validation, production monitoring, and troubleshooting for shared capabilities.
- Contribute to CI/CD improvements and automation that reduces manual effort and improves developer experience.
- Partner with adjacent teams and share knowledge through technical discussions, walkthroughs, and adoption support.

Expected Education & Experience

- 1 to 3 years of software engineering experience, including meaningful front-end or related application development work.
- Hands-on experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and a modern component-based framework, preferably React.
- Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, browser behavior, responsive design, web accessibility, and REST or GraphQL APIs.
- Experience with automated testing, debugging, Git, code review, package management, and continuous integration workflows.
- Hands-on experience using modern AI development tools such as Claude, Codex, GitHub Copilot, or comparable platforms to understand, create, test, debug, or document software.
- Exposure to agent-based workflows, Model Context Protocol (MCP), tool calling, context engineering, and evaluation of large language model output.
- Familiarity with Vite, Node.js, reusable packages, design systems, micro-frontends, cloud platforms, containers, or developer platforms such as Backstage and Harness is a plus.
- Strong problem-solving skills, clear communication, and experience collaborating in Agile or iterative development teams.
- Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.), Bachelor of Technology (B.Tech.), or an equivalent bachelor’s qualification in computer science, information technology, electronics, or a related discipline. An equivalent combination of education and relevant practical experience will also be considered.

About Athenahealth

Our vision: In an industry that becomes more complex by the day, we stand for simplicity. We offer IT solutions and expert services that eliminate the daily hurdles preventing healthcare providers from focusing entirely on their patients — powered by our vision to create a thriving ecosystem that delivers accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all.

Our company culture: Our talented  employees — or athenistas, as we call ourselves — spark the innovation and passion needed to accomplish our vision. We are a diverse group of dreamers and do-ers with unique knowledge, expertise, backgrounds, and perspectives. We unite as mission-driven problem-solvers with a deep desire to achieve our vision and make our time here count. Our award-winning culture is built around shared values of inclusiveness, accountability, and support.

Our DEI commitment: Our vision of accessible, high-quality, and sustainable healthcare for all requires addressing the inequities that stand in the way. That's one reason we prioritize diversity, equity, and inclusion in every aspect of our business, from attracting and sustaining a diverse workforce to maintaining an inclusive environment for athenistas, our partners, customers and the communities where we work and serve.

What We Can Do For You

Along with health and financial benefits, athenistas enjoy perks specific to each location, including commuter support, employee assistance programs, tuition assistance, employee resource groups, and collaborative  workspaces  — some offices even welcome dogs.

We also encourage a better work-life balance for athenistas with our flexibility. With consistent communication and digital collaboration tools, athenahealth enables employees to find a balance that feels fulfilling and productive for each individual situation.

In addition to our traditional benefits and perks, we sponsor events throughout the year, including book clubs, external speakers, and hackathons. We provide athenistas with a company culture based on learning, the support of an engaged team, and an inclusive environment where all employees are valued.

Were Hiring: Backend Engineer Terraform

Were looking for a **Backend Engineer** who can build **robust, scalable, and flexible backend systems** powering intelligent products and agentic workflows.

Youll collaborate with ML engineers, frontend developers, and designersturning prototypes into reliable, production-ready systems.

This is perfect for someone who enjoys **wearing multiple hats** and thrives in a **fast-paced, innovation-driven environment**.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Design & implement scalable APIs and service layers for AI/agent workflows
* Integrate ML models into backend infrastructure and orchestrate inference flows
* Build and optimize data access layers (databases, vector stores, external APIs)
* Define data contracts with frontend teams for seamless integration
* Develop infrastructure for orchestration, state tracking, and output management
* Contribute to DevOps (CI/CD pipelines, deployment, monitoring, logging)
* Support rapid prototyping and evolve MVPs into reusable assets
* Participate in roadmap planning and design discussions

**Desired Qualifications**

*(You dont need to check every boxfamiliarity across most areas is key.)*

**Experience**

* 4.5+ years as a Backend Engineer

**Core Skills**

* **Terraform**: proficient in writing, testing, and managing modules
* **Languages**: Python (primary), plus Go/Node.js/Java (nice-to-have)
* **API Development**: REST, GraphQL, FastAPI/Flask, microservices
* **Testing**: Pytest, unit & integration best practices
* **CI/CD**: GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, or similar
* **Cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP)**:
  + Compute: Lambda, ECS/Fargate, EC2
  + Storage: S3, EFS
  + Networking: VPC, Route53, API Gateway
  + Databases: PostgreSQL/MySQL (RDS), DynamoDB
  + Monitoring: CloudWatch, X-Ray
  + IAM policies/roles/permissions

**Nice-to-Have**

* Event-driven systems: SQS, Kafka
* ETL/Pipelines: Step Functions, Airflow (MWAA), Glue
* File formats: JSON, XML, CSV, Parquet

**Tooling**

* Git (GitHub/GitLab workflows)
* Secrets management: AWS Secrets Manager / SSM Parameter Store
* Dev tools: Docker Compose, Make, VS Code

title: Full Stack Developer (RAG/LLM)
description:
**Role Overview** We are seeking a Full Stack Developer to build, deploy, and scale web applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG). You will own the end-to-end development lifecycle, from designing responsive UIs to architecting robust backend AI pipelines.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Full-Stack Feature Delivery:** Architect and develop scalable web applications using React.js/Next.js for the frontend and Python (FastAPI)/Node.js for the backend.
* **LLM & RAG Integration:** Design and implement RAG pipelines, connecting proprietary data to LLMs via vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Qdrant, pgvector).
* **AI Orchestration:** Utilize frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or LangGraph to build intelligent agents and manage complex prompt chains.
* **API Development:** Build and maintain secure RESTful APIs to reliably serve AI model outputs and handle asynchronous user interactions.
* **Performance Optimization:** Optimize vector searches, reduce LLM response latency, and implement caching/streaming strategies for real-time generative features.

  

**Required Qualifications**

* **Experience:** 4+ years in full-stack software engineering, with actively building and deploying RAG/LLM applications in production.
* **Frontend Mastery:** Deep expertise in JavaScript/TypeScript, React.js, Next.js, and modern UI libraries (Tailwind CSS, Material UI).
* **Backend & Infrastructure:** Strong proficiency in Python (FastAPI) or Node.js, coupled with standard database management (PostgreSQL, MongoDB).
* **AI/Data Stack:** Proven hands-on experience with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic), open-source models (Hugging Face), vector embeddings, and semantic search.
* **Cloud & DevOps:** Familiarity with deploying containerized applications (Docker) and managing CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions, Vercel, or AWS/GCP.

title: AI Software Development Engineer
description:
**Software Engineer**

**Foundational Competencies**

Every Software Engineer, regardless of band, is expected to build toward the following core competencies. The job descriptions below describe how these competencies scale in scope and ownership at each level.

* Code Quality & Design clean, readable, maintainable, secure, well-tested code; strong grasp of data structures, algorithms, and OOP principles
* Problem Solving & Fundamentals strong debugging skills and the ability to break ambiguous problems into solvable pieces
* Testing & Quality Assurance — writing and maintaining automated tests, and understanding test-driven development
* System & Architecture Awareness — familiarity with design patterns, architecture patterns, databases, cloud fundamentals, caching, and scalability tradeoffs

Our Values

**Best Life**

We believe great work begins with great people. That s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work-because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.

**Growth Mindset**

We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights-personally and professionally.

**One Team**

From day one, you ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.

This role requires working from our Hyderabad office 2-3 days a week

  
 Responsibilities   
   **Connect engineering work to customer outcomes**  

* Learn how customers and staff use the product, including its important workflows, constraints, and known limitations.
* Use product and business metrics to help the team decide what to build, what to prioritize, and how to measure whether a change helped.
* Participate in customer or support discussions when your technical context can help clarify the problem and identify an actionable next step.

  
   **Own meaningful features end to end**  

* Turn an unclear problem into a shared plan, a sensible technical approach, and a clear definition of done.
* Stay with the feature through design, implementation, testing, rollout, monitoring, and follow-up instead of treating release as the finish line.
* Coordinate with Product, Design, Test, and adjacent teams so dependencies, decisions, and owners are visible early.

  
   **Apply sound engineering judgment**  

* Make technical decisions within the team s domain across service structure, APIs, data, reliability, security, observability, and maintainability.
* Record important choices, alternatives, trade-offs, and deferred work so other engineers can understand and build on the decision.
* Choose solutions that support the wider system, not only the quickest local implementation.

  
   **Build reliable software**  

* Write readable, maintainable production code with appropriate unit, integration, and contract coverage.
* Design useful logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerts so the team can understand how a change behaves in production.
* Investigate complex problems across services and database layers, identify root causes, and keep the team oriented while resolving them.

  
   **Communicate clearly and early**  

* Share status, risks, dependencies, owners, and next steps before others have to ask.
* Explain technical trade-offs to Product and customer impact to non-engineering partners without relying on internal jargon.
* Question the problem before implementation begins and recommend a path forward when requirements or constraints are unclear.

  
   **Guide others and improve the team**  

* Coach junior and mid-level engineers through reviews, pairing, design discussions, and constructive feedback.
* Help the team turn retrospectives, story mapping, and improvement ideas into decisions and follow-through.
* Share useful improvements beyond the immediate feature when they can help another squad or engineering community.

  
   **Use AI-assisted development responsibly**  

* Use AI-assisted development tools where they improve speed or clarity, while independently validating correctness, security, maintainability, and test coverage.
* Understand and take ownership of every change that reaches production, regardless of how the initial code or test suggestion was produced.

  
 Qualifications

* Demonstrated experience taking production software from an unclear problem through design, implementation, release, and follow-up.
* Strong hands-on experience developing and maintaining Java applications and services in a production environment.
* Experience with a modern Java framework, such as Spring or Spring Boot, and with designing maintainable service and API boundaries.
* Solid relational database skills, including SQL, schema design, indexing, transactions, migrations, query-performance troubleshooting, and choosing appropriate data-access patterns.
* An understanding of when relational data is the right fit and when a document, key-value, search, or other persistence approach may be appropriate.
* Experience designing or integrating REST APIs and, where relevant, asynchronous messaging or event-driven workflows.
* A practical testing approach that includes unit tests and the appropriate integration, contract, or end-to-end tests for the change.
* Experience with production observability, including structured logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and incident or problem investigation.
* Working knowledge of secure software practices, including authentication, authorization, secrets, data protection, and safe handling of customer information.
* Clear written and spoken communication with engineers, Product, Support, and other partners in a distributed or cross-functional environment.
* A record of helping other engineers grow through feedback, pairing, code review, or technical guidance.
* Equivalent practical experience is welcome; we assess demonstrated capability rather than using a degree or a strict years-of-experience cutoff as a proxy for readiness.

  
 It s Great to Have

* Experience in fitness, wellness, membership, subscription, booking, or other customer workflow products.
* Experience with cloud-hosted services, containers, CI/CD pipelines, and production release automation.
* Experience with NoSQL or search technologies, and performance or scalability improvements.
* Experience working with AI-assisted development practices and helping teammates validate AI-generated code safely.

  
 Success in the First 6-12 Months

* You can lead a meaningful feature from problem definition through release, with the right partners involved and clear follow-up after launch.
* The team continues to rely on your technical decisions about structure, data, reliability, and how the change runs in production.
* You raise unclear requirements, risks, and dependencies early and make a clear recommendation about what should happen next.
* Junior and mid-level engineers finish work more effectively with your guidance and become more independent on similar problems over time.
* You can explain the feature in customer terms and identify the product or operational outcome it is intended to improve.

title: Staff Software Engineer, Security Platform: Authentication
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As a Staff Software Engineer on GitLab's Authentication team, you'll be the technical lead for how every user, application, token, and automated agent proves who it is on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated.

We're an OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect (OIDC) provider for millions of users. We also accept identity from enterprise identity providers through Security Assertion Markup Language (SAML) and Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP). Behind that sit more than ten token types and several session methods that grew inside the Ruby on Rails monolith. You'll help us move this work onto GATE, GitLab's new authentication and authorization platform. GATE exchanges external credentials for short-lived tokens at the edge through a Secure Token Service written in Go.You'll set our technical direction, lead the hardest protocol and migration work yourself, and help senior engineers own the rest.

Our projects include:

- OAuth across Cells: Making OAuth clients, grants, and tokens work when users and organizations live in different cells

- Global identities: One user identity that works across organizations and cells

- Token consolidation: Reducing the number of token types and moving token issuance and validation out of the monolith

- Identity for artificial intelligence (AI) agents and workloads: OAuth for Model Context Protocol (MCP) clients, workload identity federation, and service identities with narrow scopes

What you'll do

- Own the technical direction for authentication protocols at GitLab, including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, SAML, and token exchange, across the Rails monolith and GATE services.

- Write and drive design documents and architecture decision records (ADRs) for multi-quarter work, then break that work into increments that ship behind feature flags.

- Lead migrations that must not break existing customers: token formats, client and grant state, and session behavior on GitLab.com, Self-Managed, and Dedicated.

- Be hands-on in the most complex parts of the code, in Ruby on Rails and Go, and review the designs and merge requests of other engineers.

- Agree interface contracts with the GATE Core, GATE Infra, Authorization, and Tenant Scale (Cells and Organizations) teams, and keep them current as the architecture changes.

- Treat authentication as a security and availability boundary: threat-model new flows, add rate limits and abuse controls, and lead the technical response to authentication incidents.

- Mentor senior and intermediate engineers on the team and raise the protocol and security knowledge of the whole group.

- Work asynchronously with engineers in India, Europe, and the Americas, with most decisions made in writing.

- Take part in on-call or operational support where your team’s ownership model requires it.

What you'll bring

- Significant experience building and running production authentication or identity systems at scale, with technical leadership across teams that moves unclear problems to written decisions and shipped code.

- Deep, hands-on knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OIDC: authorization code with Proof Key for Code Exchange (PKCE), refresh token rotation, token exchange, client registration, scopes, and JSON Web Tokens (JWTs) with signing keys and key rotation.

- Working knowledge of SAML 2.0 single sign-on and enterprise identity integration (LDAP, System for Cross-domain Identity Management (SCIM), or similar).

- Strong production experience in Ruby on Rails or Go, willingness to work in both, and experience with careful refactors, feature-flagged rollouts, and backward-compatible migrations in large, long-lived codebases.

- A security mindset. You think about token theft, replay, revocation, and blast radius before you think about elegance.

- Experience with multi-tenant software as a service (SaaS) systems, including data isolation and performance under high request volume.

- Clear, concise written English and comfort working in an all-remote, asynchronous company.

- Optional experience: authentication libraries (Doorkeeper, Devise, or OmniAuth), passkeys or multi-factor authentication, workload identity, gateways or policy engines, AI agent authentication, or multi-region architectures. Contributions to identity standards or open source identity projects are also welcome.

About the team

The Authentication group is part of the Security Platform stage, alongside Authorization, GATE Core, GATE Infra, Secrets Manager, and other security teams. We own sign-in, single sign-on, OAuth, and personal and service tokens. Our work touches every GitLab customer, and much of it is on the critical path for Cells and for GitLab's AI agent platform.

How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees

- Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being

- Flexible Paid Time Off 

- Team Member Resource Groups

- Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan

- Growth and Development Fund

- Parental Leave 

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.

Country Hiring Guidelines: GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process. 

Privacy Policy: Please review our Recruitment Privacy Policy. Your privacy is important to us.

GitLab’s policies and practices relating to recruitment, employment, career development and advancement, promotion, and retirement are based solely on merit, regardless of race, color, religion, ancestry, sex (including pregnancy, lactation, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, age, citizenship, marital status, mental or physical disability, genetic information (including family medical history), discharge status from the military, protected veteran status (which includes disabled veterans, recently separated veterans, active duty wartime or campaign badge veterans, and Armed Forces service medal veterans), or any other basis protected by law. GitLab will not tolerate discrimination or harassment based on any of these characteristics. See also GitLab’s EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. title: Senior Engineer, Backend, Procurement
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Buying software and services is still slow and fragmented at most companies. Employees don't know how to request what they need, approvals stall across finance, legal, and security, purchase orders live in a separate system from the bills that pay them, and finance teams spend month-end matching it all together by hand.


Ramp's Procurement team builds the system that connects every step of that process, from the first purchase request through sourcing, approvals, purchase orders, receiving, and matching bills and contracts back to what was ordered. Procurement sits upstream of payments and works closely with Bill Pay, Accounting, and ERP integrations, so the systems we build shape how money leaves a business long before a payment goes out.


We're looking for a senior backend engineer to own a core part of that system. You'll take responsibility for a product area such as the purchase order lifecycle, PO and bill matching, PO coding and accruals, or supplier and ERP integrations, set its technical direction within the team, and keep it healthy as customers and complexity grow. You'll work closely with product, design, and data partners to turn enterprise purchasing workflows into software that is flexible, auditable, and simple to use.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the design and evolution of a core Procurement system, such as purchase orders, receiving, or PO, bill, and contract matching, from technical design through launch, monitoring, and iteration

 - Build flexible request, intake, and approval workflows that handle the policies, approval chains, and audit requirements of complex organizations

 - Design data models that keep purchase orders, receipts, bills, and accounting data accurate and traceable from request to payment

 - Build and improve integrations with ERPs and supplier systems that stay consistent through retries, partial failures, and edits on either side

 - Help build AI-assisted features, such as automated PO coding and intelligent matching, that reduce manual work for finance and procurement teams

 - Drive technical direction for your area, connecting long-term system health to the team's roadmap

 - Work cross-functionally with product, design, and data, and with partner teams across Bill Pay, Accounting, to ship features across the full procurement lifecycle

 - Raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship



WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - Experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous workflows

 - A track record of owning a system or product area end to end: spotting problems before they are assigned, proposing the fix & working with relevant stakeholders, and shaping the area's technical direction over time

 - Strong system design judgment, especially around data correctness, auditability, and keeping complex workflows understandable

 - Product sense: you care about the customer problem, can work through ambiguous enterprise requirements, and push back when the spec is wrong

 - Clear communication and a collaborative approach to technical decisions across product, design, and engineering



NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with procurement, purchasing, accounts payable, or other B2B finance workflows

title: Senior Engineer, Backend, Bill Pay
description:
ABOUT RAMP

Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $275B in annualized spend flows in and out of 85,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.

The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.

We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.

The median Ramp customer saves 7.5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.

If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Paying vendors is one of the most manual, error-prone jobs in finance. Invoices arrive by email and PDF, get keyed in by hand, wait on approvals, and then have to be paid on time, by the right method, for the right amount, and recorded correctly in the books. A single mistake can mean a late fee, a duplicate payment, or an unhappy vendor.



Ramp's Bill Pay team builds the accounts payable system that automates that work end to end: bill intake and parsing, approvals, payment execution by ACH, check, card, and international transfer, vendor credits, and sync to customers' accounting systems. Bill Pay is one of Ramp's fastest-growing products, and businesses rely on it every day to move large amounts of money.


We're looking for a senior backend engineer to own a core part of that system. You'll take responsibility for an area such as payment execution, bill intake and AI-powered extraction, approvals, or accounting sync, set its technical direction within the team, and keep it correct and reliable as volume grows. You'll work closely with product, design, and payments partners to make accounts payable faster and more trustworthy for finance teams.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the design and evolution of a core Bill Pay system, such as payment execution, bill intake, approvals, or accounting sync, from technical design through launch, monitoring, and iteration

 - Build payment workflows that move money correctly across ACH, check, card, and international rails, with strong safeguards against duplicate, late, or incorrect payments

 - Build AI-powered AP automation, including invoice extraction, auto-coding, and agents that reduce manual review for finance teams

 - Design data models that keep every bill, approval, payment, and credit accurate and traceable through to the general ledger

 - Build reliable integrations with ERPs and accounting systems that stay consistent through retries, partial failures, and edits on either side

 - Improve the reliability, performance, and observability of Bill Pay systems as customers process larger payment volumes

 - Drive technical direction for your area and raise the engineering bar through design reviews, code reviews, and mentorship



WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - Experience designing, building, and operating production backend systems, including APIs, data models, and asynchronous workflows

 - A track record of owning a system or product area end to end and shaping its technical direction over time

 - Strong system design judgment, especially around correctness, idempotency, and reliability in systems where mistakes have real financial impact

 - Product sense: you care about the customer problem, not just the ticket, and you balance speed with quality

 - Clear communication and a collaborative approach to technical decisions across product, design, and engineering



NICE TO HAVES

title: Staff Software Engineer, Integrations
description:
It all started when engineer Fred Luddy wrote code that automated a tedious task for his coworker, Phyllis. She cried tears of joy. That moment inspired Fred to build a company that could do that for everyone—freeing people from busywork so they could focus on meaningful work. Today, ServiceNow is the AI control tower for business reinvention. Our ServiceNow AI platform brings together any AI, any data, and any workflow— helping 85% of the Fortune 500® work smarter, faster, and better. We're building an AI-native culture where technology and talent are unstoppable together. And we're just getting started.
Join us to put AI to work for people.

About Team
Flow by ServiceNow is a standalone conversational AI service desk, with its own product and its own codebase. Employees ask for help wherever they already work — Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, or the browser. Flow answers from connected knowledge, handles the request, and runs automations the team publishes. AI is how the product works, and a person stays in control when the action is sensitive. 
Flow is a new company inside ServiceNow, reimagining every function from first principles. We hire builders with agency and curiosity who use AI as the default way to design, review, and operate. They challenge inherited ways of working and treat their work as craft. 
Flow is only as good as the systems it can read and the actions it can take. On the Integrations team, you’ll own how Flow connects to the systems companies run on, including identity, devices, ticketing, documents, and chat. You’ll turn them into three things: assets Flow can inventory, knowledge it can cite, and actions it can run. Every connection keeps each source’s permissions intact. 
In your first 12 months, you’ll make sure priority systems support assets, automations, and knowledge that Flow can actually use. Connection health and failed actions will be operable without a specialist in the room, and every new system will follow one contract for permissions, audit, and proof. 
Types of problems you’ll get to work on 
- Integration generation at scale. We don’t hand-write connectors. Build the pipeline that generates them from whatever a vendor publishes, which is often not a clean OpenAPI spec — and own spec normalization, pinned provenance, and deterministic regeneration across a growing catalog. 

- Tool surfaces an AI can actually call. An action’s name, description, schema, and examples are the product surface a model sees. Design them so the assistant picks the right action first try, scope them so they are safe for an AI to call, and measure whether it does. 

- Permissions and credentials you can prove. If a file is private to HR, a marketer must not see its title, its URL, or that it exists. Own access-model mirroring and delete detection, and pick the smallest credential policy each provider needs across validation, reconnect, revocation, and tenant isolation. 

- AI-native development itself. Agentic coding is how this team ships, not a productivity add-on. Author the skills and guardrails that let agents do integration work correctly, keep the deterministic provider-fake harness that makes fast iteration possible, and review generated code critically before anything ships. 

- Engineering leadership. Raise the technical bar through architecture decisions, code review, and coaching. Partner with product and design to shape requirements and explain tradeoffs clearly. 

Our stack 
TypeScript on Bun, PostgreSQL, Temporal for durable execution, Nango as the OAuth broker. We expect you to be excellent in a comparable stack and fluent in ours within weeks. We are not screening for this list.

To be successful in this role you have: 
- Experience leveraging or critically thinking about how to integrate AI into work processes, decision-making, or problem-solving. This includes current, hands-on fluency with AI-assisted and agentic development. 

- 8+ years of software engineering with strong fundamentals in system design, API design, relational data modeling, and testing. 

- Hands-on depth building and operating third-party integrations that real tenants depended on — webhooks, rate limits, pagination, incremental sync, delete detection. 

- Experience designing API or SDK surfaces that another system consumes correctly without a human reading the documentation — and interest in doing that for a model. 

- Ownership of a versioned contract where a rename breaks a customer: stable identifiers, deprecation, and migration. 

- Sound judgment about least-privilege access — scope minimization per action, admin consent, secrets handling, tenant isolation — and about which actions an AI may take on its own. 

- Comfort with ambiguity and the drive to build from 0–1 without a playbook. 

- A record of technical leadership: architecture ownership, code-quality bar-raising, and mentoring engineers. 

Nice to have 
- Experience evaluating tool or function selection — measuring whether a model picks the right action. 

- Experience with RAG or the Model Context Protocol (MCP). 

- Familiarity with SCIM or directory sync. 

- Background in IT service management or employee support products. 

Why join us 
Intelligence is commoditizing. Connection and execution are not. A model that reasons brilliantly and cannot act on the systems a company actually runs is a demo. 
Flow already reaches a broad and growing share of the systems enterprises run day to day, and this team decides how fast that surface grows and how far each connection can be trusted. We aren’t writing connectors one at a time. We’re building the generator, the contract every provider follows, and the proof that what Flow says it did, it actually did. Real problems: a vendor specification that lies, an access model that must be mirrored exactly or not at all, a sync that resumes cleanly a million items later, and a tool surface a model has to get right without reading the documentation.

Work Personas
We approach our distributed world of work with flexibility and trust. Work personas (flexible, remote, or required in office) are categories that are assigned to ServiceNow employees depending on the nature of their work and their assigned work location. Learn more here. To determine eligibility for a work persona, ServiceNow may confirm the distance between your primary residence and the closest ServiceNow office using a third-party service.

ServiceNow is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity, veteran status, or any other category protected by law. In addition, all qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with legal requirements.

We strive to create an accessible and inclusive experience for all candidates. If you require a reasonable accommodation to complete any part of the application process, or are unable to use this online application and need an alternative method to apply, please contact globaltalentss@servicenow.com for assistance.

For positions requiring access to controlled technology subject to export control regulations, including the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), ServiceNow may be required to obtain export control approval from government authorities for certain individuals. All employment is contingent upon ServiceNow obtaining any export license or other approval that may be required by relevant export control authorities.
